facts.claim: Enterprise content is orchestrated, embedded, and written to a search index through a distinct ingestion path.
Client requests are orchestrated through hybrid retrieval, grounded generation, and response safety checks.
Azure AI Search holds the vector and keyword index used by the retrieval path.
Identity, secrets, monitoring, and cloud security apply across the workload as foundation capabilities.
Azure service nodes use official Microsoft architecture icons and keep the product name adjacent to each icon.

assumptions: The diagram is a logical reference view; networking and regional topology are intentionally omitted.
